```{r}
library(tidyverse)
hiv_data <- read_csv("HIV data 2000-2023.csv")
glimpse(hiv_data)
```


```{r}
# Extract only the numeric part (estimate) from 'Value' column
hiv_data_cleaned <- hiv_data %>%
  mutate(Value_clean = str_extract(Value, "^\\d{1,3}(?: \\d{3})*") %>%
                        str_remove_all(" ") %>%
                        as.numeric())
```


```{r}
hiv_living <- hiv_data_cleaned %>%
  filter(str_detect(str_to_lower(Indicator), "people \\(all ages\\) living with hiv"))
```


```{r}
hiv_latest <- hiv_living %>%
  filter(Period == 2023) %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  summarise(HIV_estimate = sum(Value_clean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(HIV_estimate))
```


```{r}
hiv_top75 <- hiv_latest %>%
  mutate(cum_percent = cumsum(HIV_estimate) / sum(HIV_estimate)) %>%
  filter(cum_percent <= 0.75)
```


```{r}
top_countries <- hiv_top75$Location

hiv_living %>%
  filter(Location %in% top_countries) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Period, y = Value_clean, color = Location)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Trend of People Living with HIV in Top 75% Burden Countries",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Estimated People Living with HIV"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
# Regional HIV estimates for the year 2023
regional_summary <- hiv_living %>% 
  filter(Period == 2023) %>% 
  group_by(ParentLocationCode, ParentLocation) %>% 
  summarise(Regional_HIV_Estimate = sum(Value_clean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(desc(Regional_HIV_Estimate))

print(regional_summary)
```


```{r}
library(readxl)
poverty_data <- read_excel("multidimensional_poverty.xlsx")
```


```{r}
# Check the column names in both datasets
colnames(hiv_living)
colnames(poverty_data)
```


```{r}
# Remove the unwanted columns with names like '...2', '...3', etc.
poverty_data_cleaned <- poverty_data %>%
  select(-starts_with("..."))
```


```{r}
# Trim any leading or trailing spaces
poverty_data_cleaned <- poverty_data_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    Location = str_trim(Location),
    Period = str_trim(Period)
  )
```


```{r}
# Print column names to confirm if Location exists
colnames(poverty_data_cleaned)
```


```{r}
# Remove the first column that contains metadata (it's likely the first column)
poverty_data_cleaned <- poverty_data[, -1]

# Check the column names again to see if they are cleaned up
colnames(poverty_data_cleaned)

# If there are any strange column names (e.g., extra spaces), we can clean them up
colnames(poverty_data_cleaned) <- str_trim(colnames(poverty_data_cleaned))

# View the first few rows to ensure everything is in order
head(poverty_data_cleaned)
```


```{r}
# Rename columns to something meaningful
poverty_data_cleaned <- poverty_data_cleaned %>%
  rename(
    Location = "...2",   # Adjust based on your column names
    Period = "...3"      # Adjust based on your column names
  )
```


```{r}
# Trim leading and trailing spaces from the data as well
poverty_data_cleaned <- poverty_data_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    Location = str_trim(Location),
    Period = str_trim(Period)
  )
```


```{r}
# Perform the join again
merged_data <- hiv_living %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value_clean)) %>%
  inner_join(poverty_data_cleaned, by = c("Location", "Period"))
```


```{r}
hiv_living <- hiv_living %>%
  mutate(Period = as.character(Period))
```


```{r}
poverty_data_cleaned <- poverty_data_cleaned %>%
  mutate(Period = as.character(Period))

```


```{r}
merged_data <- hiv_living %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value_clean)) %>%
  inner_join(poverty_data_cleaned, by = c("Location", "Period"))
```


```{r}
# Check the first few rows of the merged dataset
head(merged_data)
```


```{r}
# Check unique values in `Location` and `Period` in both datasets
unique(hiv_living$Location)
unique(poverty_data_cleaned$Location)

unique(hiv_living$Period)
unique(poverty_data_cleaned$Period)
```
